content.text:
The drawing shows sodium metasilicate as separate ions: two Na⁺ ions and a silicon atom. The silicon is double-bonded to one oxygen and single-bonded to two O⁻ groups.

Charges balance: two Na⁺ (+2) against two O⁻ (−2), so the whole species is neutral.

SMILES: [Na+].[Na+].[O-][Si]([O-])=O
